chunks: He will sip it, yet will not be able to gulp it down. Death will crowd in upon him from every side, but die he will not. A terrible torment trails him.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the disbeliever being unable to gulp down the drink while death comes from every side?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (15:50) vividly portrays the intermediate state of the disbeliever, emphasizing the psychological torment of prolonged life amidst inevitable death. The 'heavy punishment' (adhab ghaleez) is interpreted not merely as physical pain but as the crushing weight of regret and the realization of divine justice, a theme echoed in the concept of *Barzakh*. This state serves as a warning against the arrogance of those who reject truth, highlighting that death itself becomes a tormentor rather than a relief.
